description: Check up to 20 domain names and asking prices for listing on this market and return one sell-page link that carries them all through the seller's Square sign-in, with each name's payment-record status and estimated payout after fees. Use set_listing_terms instead to change a name already listed. Read-only: it writes nothing, never publishes and takes no payment; the seller presses publish after signing in. Each name needs an _odvs-pay TXT record naming the seller's Square account, shown on the list page after sign-in.

items.description: 1 to 20 objects of {domain, priceCents}; priceCents is whole US cents from 1000 ($10) to 2500000 ($25,000).

domain.description: A domain name such as example.com.

name: prepare_bulk_listing

sellUrl.description: Opens the sell page with every checkable name and price filled in; null when none is.

title: Prepare a bulk listing
